subject.title: test(shared): add unit tests for gateway method policy helpers

question: Should existing ElevenLabs `baseUrl` values containing query or fragment components remain supported through safe URL construction, or should they become an explicitly documented and migrated breaking validation change?
rationale: Rejecting those values changes the behavior of persisted operator configuration, and the repository policy requires explicit compatibility and migration treatment rather than silently choosing a stricter runtime contract.

options.title: Preserve or migrate existing endpoints
options.body: Keep valid existing endpoint configurations working through safe construction, or add a narrow Doctor migration and documented recovery before enforcing a new canonical form.

options.title: Accept a documented breaking validation rule
options.body: Intentionally reject query and fragment components only with explicit upgrade guidance and owner acceptance of the affected provider-configuration break.

recommendation.title: Preserve or migrate existing endpoints
recommendation.body: Keep valid existing endpoint configurations working through safe construction, or add a narrow Doctor migration and documented recovery before enforcing a new canonical form.
